titleEn: Do I Need Hotel Booking Proof for China Visa-Free Entry? Official Rules & Real-World Border Inspection Experience
titleZh: 免签入境中国，一定要准备酒店预订单吗？官方政策+边检实操全解析
summaryEn: Plenty of overseas tourists are confused whether hotel booking confirmation is mandatory document for China unilateral, mutual and 240-hour transit visa-free entry. This article sorts out official immigration regulations, real-life border inspection scenarios, actionable travel tips, and coping solutions if you have no pre-booked accommodation before arrival.
summaryZh: 大量外籍游客疑惑：单方面免签、互免签证、240小时过境免签入境中国，酒店预订单是否属于强制材料。本文梳理移民管理官方条文、口岸边检实际查验场景、落地实操建议，以及未提前预订住宿的应对办法。
contentEn:
Is hotel booking legally required for visa-free entry?

According to official Chinese immigration regulatory documents, hotel booking confirmation is not a statutorily mandatory document for unilateral visa-free, mutual visa-exemption, or 240-hour transit visa-free entry. However, Chinese border-inspection officers retain legal authority to request accommodation-related supporting documents during arrival inspection to verify your travel purpose.

Important distinction: Not legally mandatory ≠ not recommended. Border officers may conduct random spot-checks; airlines at departure airport may also ask for accommodation proof during check-in.

Practical travel advice for different accommodation scenarios

Accommodation TypeDocuments you should prepareRemarks
Commercial hotel / resortElectronic PDF or printed booking confirmation, full passenger name must match passportSave PDF offline; screenshot only is not preferred
Staying at friends’ / relatives’ private homeHost’s full residential address in China, host mobile phone number, host full nameYou still need to complete 24-hour accommodation registration afterwards
Short-term private apartment / homestayRental order, host contact & address; confirm host understands foreign-visitor registration obligationCertain homestays cannot receive foreign passport holders, double-check before payment
No pre-booking (plan to book after landing)Write down rough travel itinerary, explain to inspector clearly; prepare sufficient funds proofHigher risk of extended questioning; not recommended for first-time visitors
  • Strongly recommended: keep both offline electronic PDF and one printed copy of accommodation materials.
  • When staying with local contacts, double-check you have complete address and valid contact number of your host.
  • If you cannot provide reasonable accommodation information when requested, you will face prolonged inquiry procedures at port-of-entry; in rare cases, entry permission may be refused according to law.

Important reminder

Even if you fully satisfy visa-free eligibility conditions, the final entry-approval power belongs entirely to on-site China border-inspection officers at arrival ports. Meeting policy conditions does not guarantee 100% entry.

Frequently Asked Questions

  • Q: Can I use mobile phone screenshot of hotel booking?
    A: Screenshots are accepted in many cases, but PDF file is more reliable when mobile network fails at airport.
  • Q: Do I need bookings covering every single night of my whole stay?
    A: It is recommended to prepare full-stay bookings; partial-night bookings may trigger further questions from inspectors.
contentZh:
免签入境中国，酒店订单是法定必备材料吗？

依据中国移民管理公开法规条文，酒店预订单并不是单方面免签、互免签证、240小时过境免签的法定强制提交材料。但口岸边检工作人员依法有权在入境查验环节，要求游客出示住宿相关佐证材料，核实来华真实目的。

关键区分：非法定强制 ≠ 不需要准备。边检会开展随机抽查；部分出发地航司值机环节，同样会索要住宿证明。

不同住宿场景实操出行建议

住宿类型建议备好材料补充提示
正规酒店/度假村PDF电子版或纸质预订单，姓名必须与护照完全一致优先保存离线PDF，单纯截图不推荐
住在亲友私人住宅接待人完整国内居住地址、联系手机号、接待人全名入境后仍必须完成24小时住宿登记
私人短租民宿公寓租房订单、房东地址及联系方式；确认房东知晓外籍人员登记义务部分民宿不接待外籍护照持有人，付定金前务必确认
落地后再订房，无提前预定简单手写行程说明，备好资金证明，如实向边检解释被问询概率大幅提升，不建议首次来华游客使用
  • 强烈建议：住宿材料同时准备离线电子PDF版本+纸质打印件备查。
  • 入住亲友家中，务必完整留存接待人的居住地址与有效联系电话。
  • 无法提供合理住宿相关信息，会延长口岸问询时间；极少数情形下，边检可依法作出不予入境决定。

重要提醒

即便完全满足免签政策资格，是否准予入境的最终决定权，完全归属口岸现场中国边检工作人员；符合政策条件不等于保证一定可以入境。

高频FAQ

  • 问：酒店订单手机截图可以用吗？
    答：多数口岸可以接受截图，但机场手机无网络时PDF文件可靠性更高。
  • 问：是否需要准备全程每一晚的酒店订单？
    答：建议准备覆盖全部停留期订单；只提供部分夜晚订单，容易引发边检进一步问询。

titleEn: Can I Work or Take Internships Under China Visa-Free Policy? Clear Official Restrictions & Penalty Explanation
titleZh: 划重点：免签入境中国绝对不能打工和实习｜官方禁令与违规后果详解
summaryEn: Lots of international tourists hold misunderstanding: they think short-term internship, remote paid work, freelance work or part-time jobs are allowed under China visa-free status. This article clarifies strictly-forbidden activities, legal penalty standards, real-case risks, and correct formal application channels for working or interning in mainland China.
summaryZh: 不少外籍游客存在认知误区，误以为免签身份可以短期实习、远程有偿办公、接兼职接单。本文明确免签身份下严格禁止的行为、法律处罚标准、真实案例风险，以及来华工作实习的正规申请渠道。
contentEn:
What activities are strictly prohibited under visa-free entry?

For visitors entering via unilateral visa-free, mutual visa-exemption or 240-hour transit visa-free schemes, all paid-related work-type activities are strictly prohibited. This ban covers but is not limited to:

  • On-site paid full-time / part-time work
  • Paid internships (paid or stipend-supported internships)
  • Remote paid employment, overseas freelance work receiving Chinese-side payment
  • Commercial performances, paid speeches, commercial shooting jobs
  • Any activity for remuneration, compensation or material benefits within mainland China
Note: Unpaid volunteer work may still require special approval; do not assume all-volunteer projects are automatically permitted under visa-free entry.

Consequences of violation (Illegal employment for foreigners)

Violation LevelPotential Legal Consequences
Minor illegal-work caseForeign individual fined; employer faces heavy fines; permanent immigration violation record kept in national immigration system
Serious illegal-work situationDetention, forced deportation; entry ban to China for certain number of years
  • You cannot convert visa-free status into work permit or Z-visa inside mainland China. You must complete all procedures outside China.

If you plan to work or take internships in China

Before travelling to China, you must apply for the Z-visa (work-visa) from Chinese overseas embassies / consulates, together with pre-approved official work permit documentation issued by Chinese domestic authorities. You may only start working after completing entry and relevant post-arrival procedures.

Common Misconceptions to Avoid

  • ❌ Misconception: Unpaid internship is fine under visa-free
    ✅ Reality: Internship (even unpaid) related to employment requires corresponding visa approval.
  • ❌ Misconception: Remote work for foreign company with salary paid overseas is allowed
    ✅ Reality: Performing work-related activities inside mainland China for compensation is prohibited regardless of where your salary comes from.
contentZh:
免签入境哪些行为属于严格禁止？

通过单方面免签、互免签证、240小时过境免签入境人员，一切获取报酬类工作行为均被法律严格禁止，包含但不限于：

  • 线下全职、兼职有偿务工
  • 领取补贴、津贴的实习（有偿实习）
  • 远程有偿办公、接收中方报酬的海外接单、自由职业
  • 商业演出、付费商业演讲、商业拍摄活动
  • 在中国大陆境内获取酬劳、物质回报的各类活动
补充提示：无偿志愿活动，部分场景仍需要专门审批，不要默认免签可以直接参与志愿项目。

违规带来的法律后果（外国人非法就业）

违规严重等级可能面临法律后果
一般非法就业情形个人处以罚款；用工单位高额处罚；全国出入境系统留存违法记录
情节严重非法就业拘留、强制遣送出境；施加年限不等的来华入境限制
  • 绝对不可以在中国境内，直接把免签身份转为工作许可或者Z签证，全部手续必须在中国境外完成。

如果计划来华工作或者实习

出行之前，必须在中国驻外使领馆申请Z类工作签证，同时取得国内主管部门核发的官方工作许可批准文件；入境完成后续手续后，才可以开展工作。

高频认知误区避雷

  • ❌误区：免签做无工资实习没有问题
    ✅事实：实习即便没有薪资，涉及劳动雇佣属性，也需要对应签证审批。
  • ❌误区：给海外公司远程上班，工资海外发放就不受限制
    ✅事实：只要在中国境内从事获取报酬的工作行为，无论薪酬发放地，均属于违规。

titleEn: 24-Hour Accommodation Registration: Must-do Legal Obligation for All Foreign Visitors in China
titleZh: 来华外国人24小时住宿登记完整指南｜线上线下办理渠道、风险、材料清单
summaryEn: Accommodation registration is a statutory legal obligation under Exit-Entry Administration Law of the People’s Republic of China for every foreign national staying in mainland China, whether entering visa-free or holding regular visa. Many travellers overlook this rule and hit obstacles while applying for stay documents or when exiting China. This guide covers who needs registration, two registration channels (online & offline), required documents and risk of non-compliance.
summaryZh: 依据《中华人民共和国出境入境管理法》，住宿登记是所有在华外籍人士的法定义务，无论免签入境还是持签证入境。大量游客忽略该规定，后续办理停留证件、出境时遭遇阻碍。本文说明登记对象、线上线下双办理渠道、材料清单、未登记的法律风险。
contentEn:
Who needs to complete accommodation registration?

All foreign citizens entering mainland China, regardless of visa-free entry or holding valid Chinese visa, must finish accommodation registration within 24 hours after moving into new accommodation. Every time you change your living address inside China, you need to update your accommodation registration record promptly.

Two major registration scenarios & processing methods

Living ScenarioProcessing PartyAvailable ChannelsRequired Materials
Checking-in at formal hotel / hostelHotel front-desk completes registration automaticallyHotel internal system submit to police authorityYour original passport
Private home, short-term apartment, homestay (non-hotel)Visitor OR host / landlord1. Online: National Immigration Administration 12367 App / WeChat & Alipay Mini-program
2. Offline: local police station / community police service room		Passport original; host ID information; housing-related proof when requested

Risk & penalty for missing accommodation registration

Failing to complete registration within time limit will trigger administrative penalties according to law: warning, or fine up to RMB 2000. Without valid accommodation-registration record, you may encounter obstacles when applying for stay-related documents or going through China exit procedures. Please keep registration receipt or electronic record safely for future inspection.

Important practical tips

  • Online registration through “Immigration 12367” mini-program has equal legal validity as police-station offline processing.
  • When you change city / residential address inside China, you need to re-do accommodation registration again within 24 hours after moving-in.
  • You may call 12367 national immigration service hotline for multilingual consultation when you meet registration-related difficulties.
contentZh:
哪些人需要办理登记？

所有进入中国大陆的外籍人士，无论免签入境还是持普通签证入境，入住新住所后24小时之内必须完成住宿登记；在中国境内更换居住地址，需要及时更新住宿登记记录。

两大住宿场景办理方式对比

居住场景办理责任人可办理渠道必备材料
正规酒店、旅馆入住酒店前台自动代办报送酒店系统直接报送公安系统本人护照原件
亲友家、短租公寓、民宿（非旅馆）住宿人本人 OR 留宿人/房东1、线上：国家移民管理局12367APP、微信/支付宝小程序
2、线下：辖区派出所、社区警务室		护照原件；留宿人身份证件；必要时提供房屋相关证明

未按时办理住宿登记的风险与处罚

逾期未完成登记，依法可给予警告或者最高2000元人民币罚款。缺少有效住宿登记记录，后续申请停留类证件、出境通关均有可能遇到阻碍，请妥善保管登记回执或电子登记记录备查。

实操重要提示

  • 通过移民局12367小程序线上办理住宿登记，法律效力等同于派出所现场办理。
  • 在中国境内换城市、更换居住地址，搬家入住新住处后24小时内，需要重新办理住宿登记。
  • 办理登记遇到困难，可拨打国家移民管理局多语种服务热线12367咨询。

titleEn: Calculating China Visa-Free Stay Days: Official Rules & Common Miscalculations to Avoid
titleZh: 免签停留天数怎么算？官方规则+实例｜很多游客算错直接逾期
summaryEn: A very common mistake: numerous foreign travellers count stay-limit starting from the day they enter China. According to China’s official immigration regulation, visa-free stay duration starts counting from midnight of the calendar day after your entry date. This article explains official calculation logic with real-world examples, risk of overstay, and practical buffer-time suggestions.
summaryZh: 高频踩坑点：大量外籍游客直接从入境当天开始计算免签停留期限。依据中国官方出入境条例，免签停留时间从入境次日零时起算，入境当日不计入停留天数。本文结合真实案例拆解计算逻辑，说明逾期后果，给出行程缓冲时间实操建议。
contentEn:
Official counting rule from Chinese immigration regulation

For China unilateral 30-day visa-free policy, the permitted stay-time begins at 00:00 midnight of the day AFTER your entry date. The exact day you arrive in China does NOT count towards your allowed stay quota.

Regulation source: Article 36 of Regulations for the Administration of Exit and Entry of Foreigners of PRC: “The term of stay of a visa shall refer to the time limit for stay permitted after each entry, calculated from the day after entry.”

Concrete calculation example (30-day unilateral visa-free)

  • Entry date: August 1st
  • Counting starts: August 2nd, 00:00 midnight
  • Maximum legal departure date: August 31st
  • You must complete exit border inspection before August 31 24:00 Beijing time

What is overstay & its consequences

Overstay means you remain inside mainland China after your legal stay-expiry time. Even one-day overstay constitutes immigration violation:

  • Creates permanent immigration violation record inside national immigration-management system
  • Administrative fine will be imposed according to number of overstay days
  • Will negatively impact all your future applications for entering China (visa or visa-free eligibility)

Practical travel planning tips

  • Do NOT schedule your departure flight exactly on your final legal departure date. Reserve 2-3 natural-day buffer space for flight delays, flight cancellations or unexpected transportation disruptions.
  • Mark your latest legal departure date on your calendar or phone calendar with early-warning reminder.
  • Note: Mutual-visa-exemption agreements may apply backward-rolling-180-day cumulative-stay rules, different from unilateral visa-free simple consecutive-day counting.

FAQ

  • Q: Does 240-hour transit visa-free follow same counting rule?
    A: Yes. Transit visa-free stay period also starts counting from midnight of the day after entry.
contentZh:
官方计算规则（法规依据）

中国单方面30天免签政策，停留期限从入境次日0点开始计算，抵达中国的入境当天不计入可停留天数。

法规来源：《中华人民共和国外国人入境出境管理条例》第三十六条：签证的停留期限，是指持证人每次入境后被准许停留的时限，自入境次日开始计算。

实例演算（单方面免签30天）

  • 入境日期：8月1日
  • 开始计算时间：8月2日00:00
  • 最晚合法出境日期：8月31日
  • 必须在北京时间8月31日24点之前完成出境边检手续

什么是逾期停留，会造成哪些后果

超过合法停留期限仍然滞留中国大陆即属于逾期停留。哪怕只逾期1天，就构成出入境违法行为：

  • 国家移民管理系统留存出入境违法记录
  • 按照逾期天数处以行政罚款
  • 对未来所有来华（签证、免签入境）都会产生负面影响

行程规划实操建议

  • 不要把返程航班订在合法出境的最后一天，预留2-3天缓冲，应对航班延误、取消等突发交通问题。
  • 手机日历标记最晚合法出境日期，设置提前提醒。
  • 注意：部分互免签证协定执行向前倒推180天累计停留规则，和单方面免签连续天数计算逻辑不同。

常见问答

  • 问：240小时过境免签也是同样计算方式吗？
    答：是的，过境免签停留时间同样从入境次日零点起算。

titleEn: What Happens If My Passport Expires or Gets Lost / Stolen While I Am in China? Step-by-Step Emergency Exit Guide for Visa-Free Visitors
titleZh: 在中国境内护照到期/遗失完整处理指南｜免签游客紧急出境分步流程
summaryEn: Losing, getting stolen or expiring of your passport during your China trip is a high-stress travel emergency, especially for visa-free visitors who cannot extend stay status locally. This article provides step-by-step workflow: police loss report, embassy emergency-travel-document application, exit formalities, critical restrictions you need to know before taking action.
summaryZh: 在中国旅行途中护照遗失、被盗或者护照到期，属于旅行紧急事件，尤其免签人员无法在境内办理免签延期。本文分步拆解流程：派出所报案、本国使领馆申请紧急旅行证件、出境办理手续，同时列明行动前必须知晓的关键限制条件。
contentEn:
Scenario 1: Passport lost or stolen inside China

  1. Visit local police station where your passport was lost / stolen, file loss report and obtain official police loss-report receipt. This document is essential for following procedures.
  2. Contact your home-country embassy or consulate-general in China, submit application for emergency travel document (emergency passport / laissez-passer).
  3. Critical point: You must complete all exit-related formalities and leave China before your original visa-free stay expiry date. Emergency travel document only serves exit purpose; it will NOT grant you new visa-free-stay rights inside mainland China.
  4. Remember to update accommodation registration after you receive your new travel-document.

Scenario 2: Passport expires while you are staying in China

Visa-free entry status cannot be extended due to passport expiry. You have to contact your home-country embassy / consulate to apply for new or renewed travel-document. You still must depart China before your original permitted visa-free-stay expires.

Important note for visa-free tourists

  • Emergency travel document is only valid for exit from China; it cannot extend your existing visa-free-stay period.
  • Do not overstay waiting for new passport processing. If processing time risks crossing stay expiry, you must communicate with local Exit-Entry Administration Bureau proactively.
  • Keep copies / photos of your passport personal-info page stored offline in cloud storage before you travel to China, this will speed-up emergency procedures.

Emergency Contact Tip

When you run into passport-related emergency, you can dial 12367 China National Immigration Administration multilingual hotline for procedural consultation.
contentZh:
场景一：护照丢失或者被盗

  1. 前往护照遗失/被盗发生地辖区派出所报案，取得报案回执，该回执是后续全部手续的必备材料。
  2. 联系本国驻华大使馆或者总领事馆，申请紧急旅行证件（紧急护照/旅行证）。
  3. 关键点：所有出境手续办理、离境，必须在原本免签停留有效期内完成。紧急旅行证件仅用于出境，不会重新赋予中国大陆境内免签停留资格。
  4. 拿到新旅行证件之后，记得更新外国人住宿登记信息。

场景二：护照在中国境内到期

免签入境身份，不会因为护照到期获得延期资格。需要联系本国驻华使领馆申请换发新旅行证件；依然必须在原始免签停留期限届满前完成出境。

免签游客重要注意事项

  • 紧急旅行证件只用于离开中国，不能延长你的免签停留时间。
  • 不要为等待新证件而造成逾期。如果预计办证周期会超过停留有效期，务必主动联系当地出入境管理局沟通。
  • 来华前，把护照个人信息页拍照离线存云端，发生证件丢失时可以大幅加快应急办理流程。

紧急联系提示

遇到护照类紧急事件，可拨打国家移民管理局多语种热线12367咨询办理流程。

titleEn: 240-Hour Transit Visa-Free Pitfalls: Real-World Mistakes That Cause Entry Rejection at Chinese Airports
titleZh: 240小时过境免签高频踩坑｜机场入境被拒真实原因、硬性条件与避坑清单
summaryEn: Many travellers misunderstand the 240-hour transit visa-free policy for China. Simply holding valid passport from eligible country cannot guarantee entry approval. You must possess confirmed onward-seat ticket and genuine transit purpose travelling to a third-country / third-region. This article lists highest-frequency rejection scenarios, core legal prerequisites and practical preparation advice.
summaryZh: 大量旅客误解240小时过境免签政策，以为持有符合条件国家护照就可以直接入境。政策硬性要求必须持有已确认座位的联程客票，真实过境前往第三国/地区。本文整理高频被拒场景、核心法定前提、出行实操准备建议。
contentEn:
Core mandatory legal requirement for 240-hour transit visa-free

You must be in genuine transit status to travel onward to a third country or third-region (different from your departure origin). Round-trip flight that departs and returns back to exactly same origin-country is NOT eligible for transit-visa-free benefit.

Example: You fly from Tokyo (Japan) to Shanghai, then fly back to Tokyo (Japan). This round-trip cannot use 240-hour transit visa-free, no third-country destination exists.

Top-list common rejection reasons at port-of-entry

  • No confirmed-seat onward flight ticket that departs within 240-hour time window.
  • Your actual travel purpose is pure tourism inside China, you have no outbound flight heading to third-country / third-region.
  • Separately-purchased unconnected flight tickets without confirmed linked seat booking; separate-purchase tickets do not automatically count as transit-connection.
  • Your onward destination is Hong Kong / Macau and you then plan to fly straight back to your original departure country without another third-country-leg.

Travel preparation checklist for transit-visa-free passengers

Preparation ItemStandard Requirement
PassportMinimum 3-month remaining validity; sufficient blank visa-pages
Onward flight documentElectronic PDF / printed itinerary showing confirmed seat, flight number, exact departure datetime, destination third-country / region
Travel itineraryKeep full travel plan ready, be ready to explain transit-logic to border-inspectors

Important distinction reminder

240-hour transit visa-free onward-ticket rule is a mandatory legal requirement. This is different from unilateral / mutual visa-free entry, where return-ticket is only a practical recommendation rather than statutory requirement.
contentZh:
240小时过境免签核心硬性法定条件

必须属于真实过境，目的为前往第三国或者第三地区（区别于出发地国家）。往返只进出同一个出发国的往返航班，不满足过境免签资格。

举例：从日本东京飞上海，之后直接飞回东京。该往返行程不存在第三国目的地，不能使用240小时过境免签。

口岸高频被拒入境原因清单

  • 缺少240小时期限内已确认座位的离境联程客票。
  • 实际来华目的仅在中国境内旅游，没有飞往第三国/地区的出境行程。
  • 分开独立购买多张机票，没有确认连贯联程座位，分开购票不等于自动构成过境联程。
  • 后续仅飞往香港或澳门，之后直接飞回出发国，不存在真正第三国行程段。

过境免签出行自查清单

准备项目标准要求
护照有效期不少于3个月；留有足够空白签证页
离境机票凭证PDF电子版或纸质行程单，包含确认座位、航班号、确切起飞时间、第三国/地区目的地
行程材料保存完整行程，能够向边检清晰说明完整过境逻辑

关键区分提醒

240小时过境免签中，离境联程机票属于法定强制条件。这与单方面免签、互免签证不同，后者返程机票仅为实操建议，并非法律强制材料。

titleEn: Can I Extend My Visa-Free Stay After Arriving Inside Mainland China? Official Policy Boundaries & Emergency-Case Rules
titleZh: 免签入境后可以在中国境内延期停留吗？政策边界、仅允许的紧急情形与替代方案
summaryEn: One of the most-frequently-asked questions for visa-free visitors: many foreign travellers hope to prolong their stay after landing in China. This article clarifies official policy boundaries, force-majeure emergency-application scenarios, approval uncertainty, and better pre-departure travel-planning alternatives.
summaryZh: 免签游客最高频问题：不少外籍人员抵达中国之后希望延长免签停留时间。本文讲清官方政策边界，仅不可抗力紧急情形可以申请停留证件，审批个案审核不保证通过，以及更稳妥的出行前置规划替代方案。
contentEn:
General official rule

Unilateral visa-free, mutual visa-exemption and 240-hour transit visa-free status cannot be arbitrarily extended for tourism-purpose or personal-convenience reasons. Under normal circumstances you must depart China before your permitted stay-period expires.

Exception: only force-majeure emergency situation

Only under force-majeure circumstances such as serious medical emergency, natural disaster or other objective irresistible events, you can submit application for stay-permit document to local Exit-Entry-Administration-Bureau. Every application is reviewed case-by-case; approval is NOT guaranteed. Purely personal travel-plan change or wish to stay longer for sightseeing will not qualify for emergency-extension.

What documents you need for emergency-stay-permit application

  • Original valid passport / international travel-document
  • Official supporting proof materials for your force-majeure situation (medical-hospital documents, disaster-related official certification etc.)
  • Valid accommodation-registration record inside China

Better travel-planning advice before departure

If you already know you will need longer-than-visa-free-allowed stay before travelling, please apply for appropriate Chinese visa from overseas Chinese embassies / consulates in advance. Do NOT build your travel-plan relying on possibility of on-shore emergency-extension inside China.

What if you have already overstayed?

Do not hide or avoid authorities. Take initiative to contact local Exit-Entry-Administration-Bureau, follow official handling-procedures to resolve your status.
contentZh:
通用官方规则

单方面免签、互免签证、240小时过境免签身份，不可以因旅游、个人行程变动等普通理由随意办理延期。常规情形下，应当在允许停留期限届满前完成出境。

仅不可抗力紧急情形属于例外

仅遇到重大疾病就医、自然灾害等客观不可抗力事件，才可以向当地出入境管理局提交申请，办理停留证件。全部申请均为个案审核，不保证审批通过。单纯个人旅行计划变更、想多观光游玩，不属于可以申请延期的理由。

申请紧急停留证件一般需要准备材料

  • 有效护照或国际旅行证件原件
  • 对应不可抗力事件的官方佐证材料（医院医疗文件、灾害相关证明等）
  • 有效的在华住宿登记记录

出行前更稳妥规划建议

如果出发前就预判需要超过免签允许时长的停留，请务必在海外向中国驻外使领馆提前申请对应类型中国签证。不要把行程建立在“入境后紧急延期”的可能性之上。

万一已经发生逾期怎么办

不要躲藏回避，主动联系当地出入境管理局，按照官方流程处理身份问题。

titleEn: Tips for Preparing Return / Onward Tickets for China Visa-Free Travel: Valid Format, Low-cost-Airline Pitfalls & Policy Distinction
titleZh: 免签来华往返/联程机票准备避坑要点｜有效凭证格式、廉价航空坑点、不同免签类型政策区分
summaryEn: Return-ticket / onward-ticket requirements confuse large numbers of foreign visitors to China. Are open-jaw multi-city flight tickets acceptable? What pitfalls exist for low-cost-airline bookings? What documents are recognised by Chinese border-inspection? This article makes clear policy difference between unilateral/mutual visa-free versus mandatory-ticket requirement for 240-hour transit visa-free.
summaryZh: 往返机票要求长期困扰来华外籍游客。开口程多城市机票是否认可？廉价航空订票存在哪些坑？哪些凭证会被中国边检采信。本文区分单方面/互免签证，对比240小时过境免签的强制机票规则。
contentEn:
Which ticket formats are accepted by border-inspection authorities

Ticket TypeAcceptable?Remarks
E-ticket PDF confirmation with full-name, flight-no, exact departure date✅ AcceptableOffline PDF or printed paper copy both work
Open-jaw multi-city flight (fly-in one city, depart from different city in China)✅ AcceptableMust show confirmed seat for outbound flight leaving mainland China
Only SMS booking notice without formal itinerary document❌ Not recommendedLow-cost-airline common problem; high risk of being questioned
Open-ticket without confirmed departure date / seat❌ Not accepted for transit-visa-free; not recommended for unilateral visa-freeNo guaranteed departure schedule

Low-cost airline special warning

Many low-cost carriers only send short SMS booking notification, without formal PDF itinerary document automatically delivered to your mailbox. Before travelling to China, manually download full official flight-itinerary page from airline official website or mobile-app, save as offline PDF file. Simple SMS text message is not ideal supporting-document for border-inspection or airline check-in.

Critical policy distinction you must understand

  • Unilateral visa-free / mutual visa-exemption: Return / onward flight ticket is a strong practical recommendation by immigration authority, but not statutory mandatory document.
  • 240-hour transit visa-free: Confirmed onward-ticket with seat reservation is a statutory mandatory requirement for eligibility; without it you will very likely get rejected entry.

Practical tip for departure-airline check-in

Even if China border law does not mandate return-ticket for unilateral visa-free, your departure-country airline ground-staff may request onward-ticket proof before issuing boarding pass. Always prepare your flight documents well before airport-check-in.
contentZh:
哪些机票凭证格式会被边检认可

机票凭证类型是否可采信补充说明
包含完整姓名、航班号、确切起飞日期的电子客票PDF确认单✅ 认可离线PDF、纸质打印件均可
开口程多城市机票（入境A城市，从国内另一城市出境）✅ 认可必须展示确认有效的离开中国大陆出境航班座位
仅有短信预定通知，无正式行程单文件❌ 不推荐廉价航空高频问题，容易被航司、边检问询
无确定日期、无确认座位的开放机票❌ 过境免签不接受；单方面免签也强烈不建议使用没有确定离境时间保障

廉价航空特别提醒

部分廉价航空只会发送简短短信预定通知，不会自动向邮箱推送正式PDF行程单。来华出行前，请手动从航司官网或APP下载完整官方行程页面，保存为离线PDF。单纯短信文本，不适合作为边检、出发地航司值机的证明材料。

必须搞懂的政策重要区分

  • 单方面免签 / 互免签证：往返/离境机票属于移民管理部门强烈实操建议材料，不属于法律强制提交文件。
  • 240小时过境免签：带确认座位的离境联程机票属于法定硬性要求，缺少该材料极大概率入境被拒。

出发地航司值机实操提示

即便中国内地边检法规对单方面免签不强制返程机票，你出发机场的航司地勤，仍然有可能在发放登机牌前查验离境机票证明。务必提前备好全套行程材料。

titleEn: Common Misunderstandings About China Mutual Visa Exemption Agreements: 5 Key Points Many Travellers Get Wrong
titleZh: 互免签证协定最容易被误解的5个知识点｜双边协定规则避坑
summaryEn: Lots of travellers hold wrong assumptions about mutual visa-exemption treaties between China and foreign countries: believing mutual visa exemption brings unlimited-stay permission, works for every passport-type, or equals permanent-residence right. This article clarifies passport-type limits, backward-rolling-180-day cumulative-stay-count rule, bilateral-treaty constraints and real-life travel-risks.
summaryZh: 不少游客对中外互免签证协定存在大量误区：以为互免就可以无限停留、所有护照都能用、等同于长期居留。本文厘清护照类型限制、向后倒推180天累计停留算法、双边条约约束，以及实际出行风险。
contentEn:
1. Not every passport qualifies for mutual-visa-exemption treaties

Bilateral mutual-visa-exemption agreements apply only to ordinary passports. Diplomatic passports, official / service passports follow separate independent treaty-provisions, not covered by tourist-oriented mutual-visa-exemption rules.

2. Backward-rolling 180-day cumulative-stay rule (critical difference vs unilateral visa-free)

Several China-foreign mutual-visa-exemption treaties adopt backward-rolling-180-day cumulative-stay-restriction: calculate backwards 180 calendar-days starting on your current-entry-date. Even if you exit China and re-enter later, your total accumulated stay-days inside this rolling-180-day window cannot exceed treaty-allowed maximum days. This rule is different from unilateral-visa-free simple consecutive-day counting.

Example: If treaty allows 90-days stay within rolling-180-days: you cannot stack multiple-short-entry visits to accumulate more than 90-days within any backward-180-day window.

3. Mutual-visa-exemption ≠ permanent-residence or long-term-stay qualification

Mutual-visa-exemption only grants short-term entry permission for tourism, business-visit, family-reunion etc. You cannot apply for long-term residence permit, work-permit or study-status purely relying on mutual-visa-exemption entry-status.

4. Mutual-visa-exemption still obeys entry-inspection final-decision principle

Owning eligible ordinary-passport under mutual-treaty does not guarantee entry. Chinese border-inspection officers retain authority to refuse entry if you fail inspection or have inadmissibility-circumstances.

5. Same-prohibited-activity list applies for mutual-visa-exemption

Mutual-visa-exemption visitors are also strictly forbidden from paid-work, internship, formal-study, journalist reporting, commercial-performance, same as unilateral-visa-free-tourists.
contentZh:
1、不是所有护照都适用互免签证协定

中外双边互免签证协定，仅针对普通护照生效；外交护照、公务/公务普通护照执行独立的双边条约条款，不适用面向普通游客的互免签证规则。

2、向后倒推180天累计停留规则（和单方面免签核心区别）

部分中外互免签证协定执行向前倒推180天累计停留限制：以本次入境日期为基准向前回溯180个自然日。即便出境之后再次入境，在该180天滚动周期内全部累计停留总天数，不能超过协定约定上限。该计算逻辑与单方面免签简单连续天数计算不一样。

举例：协定允许180天周期内最多停留90天：不能通过多次短入境，在任意倒推180天窗口内累积超过90天停留。

3、互免签证不等于永久居留或者长期居留资格

互免签证仅授予旅游、商务访问、探亲等短期入境权限。不可以仅凭互免签证入境身份，申请长期居留许可、工作许可或者留学身份。

4、互免签证同样遵循边检最终决定权原则

持有符合协定的普通护照，不等于保证一定可以入境。如查验发现不符合入境条件，中国边检有权依法不予入境。

5、互免签证身份禁止行为与单方面免签完全一致

互免签证入境人员同样严禁有偿工作、实习、正式留学、记者采访、商业演出，和单方面免签游客约束完全相同。

titleEn: Pre-departure Checklist Before You Travel to China Visa-Free: Complete Item-by-Item Risk-Check List
titleZh: 免签来华出行前自查清单｜逐项核对，降低入境与旅行风险
summaryEn: Handy comprehensive pre-departure checklist created specially for foreigners travelling to China under visa-free schemes. It covers passport validity standards, documents recommended to prepare, strictly-prohibited-activities you must avoid, time-buffer planning for travel-delay risks, and quick-reference check-box format for travellers.
summaryZh: 专为免签来华外籍旅客整理的完整出发自查清单，包含护照有效期标准、建议备好备查材料、必须规避的禁止行为、应对延误风险的时间预留规划，提供可直接勾选的参考格式。
contentEn:
✅ Passport pre-flight check

  • Ordinary passport validity: ≥ 6-months remaining for unilateral / mutual visa-free entry; minimum ≥3-months for 240-hour transit visa-free entry.
  • Sufficient blank visa-pages inside passport (at least two full blank pages; endorsement / remark pages at back do NOT count).
  • Passport physical condition intact: no heavy water-damage, torn-pages or unauthorised stamps.
  • Save offline photos of passport personal-info page on cloud storage and local mobile-device.

✅ Documents recommended to prepare for border-inspection spot-check

  • Return / onward flight itinerary PDF (offline saved).
  • Hotel booking confirmation OR host full-address + host-phone-number for private-accommodation.
  • Sufficient-funds supporting material: bank-statement, valid credit-card (non-mandatory but strongly recommended).
  • Brief travel-itinerary document introducing your travel-plan inside China.

❌ Activities strictly forbidden under visa-free entry status

Do NOT take-part in following activities when entering under any visa-free-scheme:

  • Paid-work, internship (including stipend-internship), freelance-paid-work
  • Formal-study / enrolment into Chinese educational-institutions
  • Journalism reporting, news-gathering activities
  • Commercial-performance, paid-speech, commercial-shooting-work

✅ Time-buffer & schedule risk prevention

  • Do NOT book departure flight exactly on your last legal-departure-day. Reserve 2-3 buffer-days for flight-delay, flight-cancellation or transportation disruptions.
  • Mark your latest-legal-exit-date inside your phone calendar, set advance-reminder.

✅ After-arrival mandatory-reminder

  • Complete 24-hour accommodation-registration after you check-in to any accommodation.
contentZh:
✅ 护照出发前自查

  • 普通护照有效期：单方面/互免签证入境剩余有效期≥6个月；240小时过境免签最少≥3个月。
  • 护照留有足够空白签证页（至少2页完整空白页；末尾备注批注页不算有效签证页）。
  • 护照本体完好，无严重泡水、撕页、非官方印章污损。
  • 把护照个人信息页拍照，本地设备+云端双重离线保存。

✅ 建议随身携带以备边检抽查的材料

  • 往返/离境机票行程单PDF，离线保存。
  • 酒店预订单；若住私人住宅准备接待人完整地址+联系电话。
  • 资金佐证材料：银行流水、有效信用卡（非强制，但强烈建议准备）。
  • 简单的在华旅行行程说明。

❌ 免签身份严禁参与的活动

无论哪一类免签入境，都不可以从事下面行为：

  • 有偿工作、实习（含领取补贴实习）、接单类有偿自由职业
  • 正式留学、在中国院校注册就读
  • 新闻采访、新闻采编类活动
  • 商业演出、付费演讲、商业拍摄工作

✅ 时间缓冲与行程风险防范

  • 不要把返程航班订在合法出境的最后一天；预留2-3天缓冲，应对航班延误、取消等交通意外。
  • 手机日历标记最晚合法出境日期，设置提前提醒。

✅ 入境之后必做提醒

  • 入住任何住所之后，务必按时完成24小时住宿登记。

titleEn: Essential Mobile Apps for Foreign Travellers Visiting China: Complete Tool-List, Usage Notes & Registration Tips
titleZh: 外国人来华必备手机APP完整清单｜工具用途、注册难点、使用注意事项
summaryEn: Mobile-application ecosystem inside mainland China differs from overseas markets. Installing proper mobile-tools before arrival will greatly improve your travel experience. This article covers map-navigation, real-time-translation, ride-hailing, government-service-apps, explains registration-barriers and practical work-around advice for overseas visitors.
summaryZh: 中国大陆手机应用生态与海外市场存在差异，抵达前准备好对应工具，可以大幅提升旅行体验。本文覆盖地图导航、实时翻译、网约车、政务服务类APP，说明海外用户注册难点和实操解决办法。
contentEn:
Maps & Navigation

Amap (Gaode Maps) and Baidu Maps are the most stable and widely-used navigation services within mainland-China. Google Maps functionality is heavily limited under local network environment. If you plan to travel to remote mountain / plateau regions, download offline-map packages for target cities before you arrive. Both Amap and Baidu support English-language interface.

Translation tools

DeepL, iFlytek Translation app support real-time voice-translation, camera-photo-translation. Very practical for street-chatting, restaurant-ordering, reading public-sign-boards when you have limited Chinese-language ability.

Transport & taxi / ride-hailing

Didi is the dominant ride-hailing platform in China. Overseas users can bind international credit-cards (Visa / Mastercard) inside Didi App without needing Chinese domestic bank-card.

Government-service official app for foreigners

“Immigration 12367” App / mini-program: for online foreign-visitor accommodation-registration, immigration-related consultation, multilingual-service hotline-entrance.

Important registration-note

Certain domestic Chinese-apps require mainland-China mobile-phone-number for full-feature registration. After landing in China you can purchase local-SIM-card or activate e-SIM to obtain Chinese phone-number for registration purpose.
contentZh:
地图导航

高德地图、百度地图，是中国大陆环境下最稳定普及的导航软件；谷歌地图在本地网络环境功能受限。计划前往山区、高原等偏远地区，建议抵达前下载目标城市离线地图包。高德、百度均支持英文界面。

翻译工具

DeepL、讯飞翻译APP，支持实时语音翻译、拍照翻译。中文能力有限时，逛街沟通、餐厅点餐、识别公共标识都非常实用。

交通网约车

滴滴出行是国内主流网约车平台，海外用户无需内地银行卡，可以直接绑定Visa/Mastercard境外信用卡使用。

面向外国人的政务官方APP

移民局12367 APP/小程序：支持线上办理外国人住宿登记、出入境业务咨询、多语种服务热线入口。

注册重要提示

部分国内APP完整功能注册，需要中国大陆手机号。抵达中国之后，可以办理本地实体SIM卡或者eSIM虚拟卡获取国内手机号完成注册。

titleEn: How to Get Mobile Internet in China: Comparison of International Roaming, Physical SIM Card & e-SIM, Pros-Cons & Practical Buying Advice
titleZh: 来华如何解决手机网络：国际漫游、实体SIM卡、eSIM优缺点对比与选购实操
summaryEn: Stable mobile internet connection is critical for overseas tourists travelling inside China. Three mainstream connectivity-solutions: international roaming, local physical-SIM-card and e-SIM virtual-card. This article compares their pros, cons, price-level, purchase-channel and important network-regulation reminder for foreign-visitors.
summaryZh: 稳定手机网络对来华海外游客至关重要。主流三种上网方案：国际漫游、本地实体SIM卡、eSIM虚拟卡。本文对比三者优缺点、价格区间、购买渠道，同时给外籍游客重要网络法规提醒。
contentEn:
Three mainstream mobile-internet solutions comparison table

SolutionProsConsSuitable-Crowd
International roaming (home-country SIM-card)No card swap needed; simple activation before departureHigh data-traffic cost; data-package often expensive for long-stayShort-stopover within 1-3 days, minimal-data-usage

e-SIM virtual-cardNo physical-card-swap; can purchase & activate online before departureOnly supported by e-SIM-compatible modern smartphonesMost-recommended for modern-smartphone users

Purchase-channel tips

  • Physical SIM-card: Main-arrival-halls of major international airports have telecom-operator retail-kiosks; you need to show your passport for real-name-registration as required by Chinese regulation.
  • e-SIM: Purchase from authorised overseas-vendor websites before you fly to China; activate after you land inside mainland-China.

Critical regulatory reminder

According to Chinese network-regulation rules, private-individual use of VPN service is not permitted inside mainland-China. Global overseas-social-media platforms cannot be accessed without authorised official-approved channels.
contentZh:
三大主流上网方案对比表

上网方案优点缺点适合人群
本国SIM卡国际漫游无需换卡，出发前简单开通即可流量资费偏高，长期停留成本高1-3天短暂中转、流量消耗很小的旅客
中国运营商本地实体SIM卡流量价格实惠，国内网络稳定手机必须无锁；凭护照实名登记，机场/线下门店办理中长时间旅行，对预算敏感游客
eSIM虚拟卡不用更换实体卡片，出发前线上购买仅支持具备eSIM功能的新款智能手机手机支持eSIM的游客，优先推荐

购买渠道实操提示

  • 实体SIM卡：大型国际机场到达大厅设有运营商售卖柜台；按照国内法规，必须出示护照完成实名登记。
  • eSIM：来华前在正规海外服务商网站购买，抵达中国大陆之后再完成激活。

重要法规提醒

依据中国网络相关法规，中国大陆境内个人私自使用VPN属于违规行为。境外海外社交平台，无法通过非官方合规渠道访问。

titleEn: Cash vs Mobile Payment: How Foreign Tourists Complete Payment in Mainland China (Full Practical Guide)
titleZh: 现金与移动支付｜外国游客在中国付款完整实操指南
summaryEn: QR-code-based mobile payment dominates consumption scenarios inside China, which frequently creates payment-difficulties for overseas tourists without Chinese local bank-accounts. This article explains cash-usage suggestions, credit-card acceptance scope, tourist-oriented digital-payment solutions, and real-world spending tips for foreign-visitors.
summaryZh: 中国大陆消费场景以二维码移动支付为主，没有内地银行卡的海外游客经常遭遇付款难题。本文讲解现金使用建议、信用卡受理范围、面向境外游客的数字支付方案，以及真实消费实操提示。
contentEn:
Carry small-amount RMB cash for emergency scenarios

Small street-side shops, old-style taxis, small-scale local-street-vendors often cannot process card or QR-code payment. Always keep small-denomination RMB bank-notes in your wallet for unexpected-situations.

Visa / Mastercard credit-card acceptance scope

  • ✅ Supported: Large-scale shopping-malls, international-brand hotels, high-end chain-restaurants, major-airport-retail-shops.
  • ❌ Usually NOT supported: Small local-family-run restaurants, street-food-stalls, small-community-shops, regular-city-taxis.

Special tourist-oriented digital-payment solutions (no mainland-bank-account required)

  • Alipay Tour Card: Overseas-visitor version of Alipay, supports binding international credit-cards for QR-code consumption.
  • WeChat Tourist Wallet: WeChat special tourist-mode wallet for overseas-passport-holders, supports international-card top-up for QR-code payment.

Practical spending advice

  • Exchange a small-amount of Chinese Yuan cash right after airport-arrival for emergency-purpose. Do NOT exchange huge-amount cash all-at-once.
  • Do not fully rely solely on credit-card or mobile QR-payment; always prepare cash-backup.
contentZh:
常备小额人民币现金应对应急场景

街边小店、老式出租车、小型路边摊贩，很多不支持刷卡或者二维码支付。钱包常备小面额人民币纸币，应对突发无法扫码付款场景。

Visa/Mastercard信用卡受理范围

  • ✅可以使用：大型购物中心、国际品牌酒店、高端连锁餐厅、机场大型商铺。
  • ❌大多无法使用：本地小家庭餐馆、路边小吃摊、社区小店、普通城市出租车。

面向境外游客专属数字支付方案（无需内地银行卡）

  • 支付宝境外游客版（Alipay Tour Card）：海外游客模式，可绑定境外信用卡实现二维码消费。
  • 微信游客钱包：专门面向持外国护照来华游客，支持境外信用卡充值，完成二维码付款。

实操消费建议

  • 抵达机场之后兑换少量人民币现金留作应急，不要一次性兑换大额现金。
  • 不要完全依赖信用卡或者手机扫码支付，务必准备现金作为备用。

titleEn: Simple Chinese Dining Etiquette Foreign Travellers Should Know: Avoid Cultural Awkwardness at Restaurants & Banquets
titleZh: 外国游客需要了解的中国餐桌礼仪小常识｜避开聚餐饭局文化尴尬
summaryEn: Understanding basic Chinese-dining customs helps foreign travellers avoid awkward cultural-misunderstanding during restaurant meals, family-dinners and business-banquets. This article covers chop-taboos, tipping-culture, shared-dish convention and toasting-etiquette with real-life practical explanation.
summaryZh: 了解基础中国餐桌习俗，帮助外国游客在餐厅用餐、家庭聚餐、商务宴会时，避免文化误解造成尴尬。本文讲解筷子禁忌、小费文化、合餐习惯以及敬酒礼仪，结合现实场景通俗解读。
contentEn:
Chopstick manners & taboos

  • Never stick chopsticks vertically upright into rice bowl, this gesture is associated with traditional funeral rituals and considered inauspicious.
  • Do not tap bowls with chopsticks; do not wave chopsticks around while talking.

Tipping culture in mainland China

Tipping is NOT a mainstream custom across mainland China. You do not need to give extra cash tips for restaurant waiters, taxi drivers or hotel housekeeping staff. Extra tipping may even make local people feel uncomfortable.

Shared-dishes & serving chopsticks custom

Most Chinese-style restaurants adopt shared-dining culture, dishes are placed in middle of table for everyone to share. Many restaurants will provide separate public serving-chopsticks and spoons for picking food from shared plates, please use them when available.

Toasting custom at banquets

At formal dinners or banquets, local people may propose toasts. You have full right to politely decline alcohol drinks. You can use tea, juice or mineral water as replacement beverage for toasting.

Extra practical dining FAQ

  • Q: Is it rude to leave some food unfinished on plate?
    A: Leaving small portion food is acceptable; finishing every bite completely does not mean you must order more dishes.
contentZh:
筷子用法与忌讳

  • 不要把筷子竖直插在米饭碗当中，该手势和传统丧葬习俗相关，属于不吉利的忌讳。
  • 不要拿筷子敲打碗碟；交谈的时候不要挥舞筷子。

中国大陆小费文化

在中国大陆没有给小费的主流习俗。餐厅服务员、出租车司机、酒店保洁都不需要额外支付小费，主动多给小费有时反而会让当地人感到局促。

合餐与公筷习惯

绝大多数中餐厅实行合餐文化，菜品放置桌子中央供所有人分享。不少餐厅会专门提供公筷公勺用来夹取大盘菜品，有提供的情况下建议优先使用。

宴席敬酒习俗

正式聚餐、宴会场合会出现敬酒环节。你完全可以礼貌委婉拒绝饮酒，可以用茶水、果汁、矿泉水代替酒水回敬。

用餐额外常见问答

  • 问：盘子里面剩菜是否不礼貌？
    答：少量剩余饭菜属于正常，不需要为了光盘强行多点菜品。

titleEn: Public Transport Tips: Subway & High-Speed Rail for Foreign Tourists, Ticketing, ID-Check & Luggage Rules
titleZh: 外国游客乘坐中国地铁与高铁出行完整提示｜购票、证件核验、行李规定
summaryEn: China high-speed rail and metro systems are very convenient for sightseeing. This article covers passport-based ticket purchase, real-name ID-check procedures, luggage size-weight restrictions, station arrival suggestions and common pitfalls for overseas visitors.
summaryZh: 中国高铁、地铁系统非常适合观光出行。本文讲解凭护照购票、实名核验流程、行李尺寸重量限制、到站时间建议，以及外籍游客高频踩坑点。
contentEn:
High-speed rail ticket purchase & real-name check

China high-speed railway implements strict real-name-ID system. Foreign visitors can buy train tickets with original passport at railway-station manual ticket counters. Some third-party travel platforms support foreign-passport booking online. When boarding trains you must present your physical original-passport for identity verification; passport photo or screenshot is generally invalid.

High-speed-rail carry-on luggage restrictions

Item CategoryRequirement
Carry-on luggage weightAdults max 20 kg per passenger
Sum of length-width-heightTotal dimension shall not exceed 130 cm
Prohibited carry-onSharp dangerous goods, large-size liquids, flammable articles

City subway / metro usage

Most urban subway systems support QR-code ride-codes. To obtain tourist-oriented ride-code you may need to complete real-name registration with passport. You can also buy one-time-use paper metro tickets at station vending-machines.

Important station arrival reminder

Major high-speed-rail stations cover huge area, security-check and walking distance take long time. Arrive at station at least 30 minutes before your train departure time. Boarding gates will close several minutes prior to departure.

Common mistake warning

Do not forget to bring physical passport when you take high-speed-trains; electronic copy cannot pass gate inspection.
contentZh:
高铁购票与实名核验

中国高铁执行严格实名制度。外国游客可以在火车站人工窗口凭护照原件购买火车票；部分第三方旅行平台支持使用外国护照线上订票。乘车检票时，必须出示实体护照原件，护照照片、截图一般不能通过闸机核验。

高铁随身行李限制

项目分类具体要求
随身行李重量成人每位最多20公斤
长宽高三边之和总和不超过130厘米
禁止随身携带尖锐危险品、大瓶液态物品、易燃易爆物件

城市地铁使用

绝大多数城市地铁支持二维码乘车码。申领游客乘车码，有可能需要使用护照完成实名登记；也可以在车站自助机购买纸质单程地铁票。

到站重要提醒

大型高铁站占地面积很大，安检加上站内步行耗时久，请至少发车前30分钟抵达车站。列车发车前数分钟检票闸机就会关闭。

高频错误提醒

乘坐高铁务必携带实体护照原件，电子副本无法过闸机。

titleEn: Common Tourist Scams in China and How Foreign Visitors Can Avoid Them, Safety Guide
titleZh: 来华游客常见骗局以及如何规避｜外籍旅行者安全防护指南
summaryEn: Most tourist destinations across China maintain good public-security conditions, but a small number of targeted tourist-traps still exist. This article lists typical scam-types targeting foreign-visitors, practical response-skills and emergency-contact information for reference.
summaryZh: 中国绝大多数旅游目的地治安状况良好，但仍然存在少量专门针对外国游客的圈套陷阱。本文列举典型骗局类型、实操应对技巧以及紧急联系方式供参考。
contentEn:
Typical tourist-traps targeting overseas-visitors

  • Tea-house / art-gallery scam: Strangers on street start friendly small-talk, invite you for tea-tasting or art-appreciation, afterwards charge extremely high fees for drinks or artwork.
  • Unlicensed taxi / black-car overcharging: Near scenic-spots, unlicensed private-car drivers quote sky-high prices for short-distance rides.
  • Fake-souvenir overpricing: Street vendors sell counterfeit antiques or handicrafts with inflated price to foreign-looking tourists.

Safety & response advice

  • Politely but firmly reject unsolicited invitations and small-talk from unknown strangers on street.
  • Prefer official Didi ride-hailing service; avoid taking unlicensed private black-cars around scenic-areas.
  • Save important emergency-numbers inside your mobile-phone: local police 110, hotel front-desk contact, 12367 national immigration hotline.
  • If you get trapped in scam-conflict, move to crowded public-place first and dial 110 for police assistance.

Quick-reference emergency-number note

110 is China universal police-emergency number; you may dial it for disputes, fraud and personal-safety-related incidents.
contentZh:
专门针对海外游客的典型旅游陷阱

  • 茶馆画廊骗局：街头陌生人主动搭话闲聊，邀请品茶、看画展，之后向你收取高额茶水或者艺术品费用。
  • 黑车漫天要价：景区周边无资质私车司机，短途行程报虚高车费。
  • 纪念品虚高售卖：路边摊贩向外国游客高价兜售仿冒古董、劣质手工艺品。

安全与应对建议

  • 对于街头陌生人主动搭讪邀约，礼貌并且坚决拒绝。
  • 优先使用官方滴滴网约车，景区周边不要乘坐无资质黑私车。
  • 手机保存关键紧急号码：报警110、酒店前台联系方式、国家移民12367热线。
  • 一旦陷入骗局纠纷，优先移动到人多公共场所，拨打110寻求警方帮助。

紧急号码速查

110是中国通用报警电话，遭遇纠纷、诈骗、人身安全事件均可拨打。

titleEn: Medical Guide for Foreign Tourists: Getting Sick During Travel in China, Hospital Options & Insurance Tips
titleZh: 外国游客就医指南：在中国旅行生病怎么办｜医院选择与保险提示
summaryEn: When you fall ill while travelling in China, it is important to know how to seek proper medical-service. This article compares public general-hospitals and international clinics, reminds you about travel-medical-insurance, documents you need during hospital-visits and claim-reimbursement tips.
summaryZh: 在中国旅行途中生病，需要了解如何获取合适医疗服务。本文对比公立综合医院与涉外国际诊所，提醒旅行医疗保险，就医需要携带材料以及保险理赔要点。
contentEn:
Two main types of medical institutions

Hospital TypeAdvantagesDisadvantages
Public general hospitalComplete medical departments, wide-range treatment capabilities, relatively reasonable priceLimited English-speaking staff; large patient-flow, long waiting-time during peak hours
International clinic / Sino-foreign medical centreEnglish-speaking medical staff, more comfortable service-experienceService price is significantly higher than public hospitals

Travel medical-insurance suggestion

Strongly recommend purchasing travel-insurance covering overseas-medical-expense before departing your home-country. Many visa-free visitors overlook medical-insurance preparation. Double-check that policy coverage includes mainland-China territory.

Important practical reminders for hospital-visit

  • Bring your original passport for hospital registration procedures.
  • Keep all medical invoices, examination reports and receipts safely, these documents are required for insurance-claim reimbursement.
  • For severe emergency-medical-situation you can dial 120 China national ambulance emergency-number.
contentZh:
两类主要医疗机构对比

医院类型优点缺点
公立综合医院科室齐全，诊疗能力全面，价格相对合理会说英语工作人员有限；人流量大，高峰时段等候久
国际诊所/中外医疗中心医护可使用英语沟通，服务体验更舒适收费显著高于公立医院

旅行医疗保险建议

强烈建议出发前购买覆盖海外医疗开销的旅行保险，不少免签来华游客会忽略保险准备。务必确认保险保障地域包含中国大陆。

就医实操重要提醒

  • 就医挂号登记需要携带护照原件。
  • 妥善保管全部医疗发票、检查报告单，保险理赔需要用到这些凭证。
  • 遇到危重医疗紧急情况，可以拨打中国救护车急救号码120。

titleEn: Shopping & Souvenir Tips for Foreign Visitors Traveling in China: Bargain Skills & Customs Export Restrictions
titleZh: 外国游客在中国购物买伴手礼实用提示｜砍价技巧与海关出境限制
summaryEn: Practical guidance for buying souvenirs, local handicrafts and specialty goods in China. Distinguish scenarios where bargaining is acceptable, and learn customs-export prohibitions to avoid having goods detained at airport departure.
summaryZh: 在中国购买纪念品、手工艺品、地方特产实操指引，分清哪些场景可以砍价，同时了解海关出境禁令，避免商品在离境机场被扣留。
contentEn:
Bargaining rules for different shopping-scenarios

  • ✅ Open-air local street-markets, small independent-vendor stalls: bargaining is common and expected, you can negotiate price moderately.
  • ❌ Large-scale shopping-malls, brand-chain-stores, official museum-gift-shops: fixed-price only, price negotiation is not accepted.

Critical customs-export restrictions you must know

  • Antique cultural-relics without formal export-approval documents cannot be taken out of China.
  • Wild-animal-related protected products are strictly prohibited for export.
  • Do not purchase so-called “ancient antiques” from unlicensed street-side vendors; many are counterfeit and you risk customs confiscation.

Receipt preservation advice

Keep shopping receipts and invoices especially for expensive handicrafts, art-works or specialty-goods. Customs officers may request to check purchase-documents when you depart China.

Extra shopping FAQ

  • Q: Can I buy Chinese tea and take it back home?
    A: Dried tea-leaves are generally allowed for personal carry-on, subject to import quarantine-rules of your home-country.
contentZh:
不同购物场景砍价规则

  • ✅露天本地集市、个体小摊贩摊位：普遍可以砍价，可以适度协商价格。
  • ❌大型购物中心、品牌连锁门店、博物馆官方礼品店：明码标价，不接受议价。

必须了解的海关出境限制

  • 没有正规出口审批文件的文物古董，不能携带出境。
  • 受保护野生动物相关制品严禁携带出境。
  • 不要在无资质街边摊贩处购买所谓古董，很多属于仿品，还存在被海关没收风险。

票据保存建议

贵重手工艺品、艺术品、特产务必保留购物小票和发票，出境海关有可能核验购买凭证。

购物补充问答

  • 问：可以买茶叶带回本国吗？
    答：干茶叶个人携带出境一般允许，但要遵守你本国的进口检疫规定。

titleEn: Weather & Clothing Preparation for Traveling Across Different Regions of China, Regional Climate Breakdown
titleZh: 中国不同地区旅行天气与衣物准备建议｜各地气候特点拆解
summaryEn: China has vast territory with huge climate differences across regions. Same calendar month can bring hot summer weather in the south while cool or cold autumn-winter conditions in northern or plateau-areas. This guide helps you pack suitable clothing before travel.
summaryZh: 中国国土辽阔，不同地域气候差异巨大。同一个月份，南方正值盛夏，北方或者高原地区已经转凉入冬。这份指南帮助你出行前收拾合适衣物。
contentEn:
Regional climate overview & packing tips

RegionClimate CharacteristicClothing & gear suggestion
South-China / Southeast-ChinaHot & humid summer; heavy rainfall, typhoon risk June-SeptemberLight breathable summer-clothes, raincoat / folding umbrella, anti-sun accessories
North-China (Beijing, Tianjin etc.)Big day-night temperature gap in spring-autumn; cold freezing winterLayer-style dressing; thick warm outer-coat for winter-season
Western plateau (Qinghai, Tibet)Strong ultraviolet radiation; large temperature difference between day and night even in summerSunscreen, sun-hat, sunglasses; long-sleeve layers even during summer months
South-West mountain areaHigh humidity, frequent light-rain all-year-roundWater-proof footwear, portable rain-gear

Practical travel tip

Weather can change rapidly. Before travelling to each new city, look up multi-day local weather forecast in advance and adjust your clothing-packing accordingly.

Warning note

Even summer-season on plateau areas, nights can drop to quite low temperature; do not only bring short-sleeve garments.
contentZh:
各区域气候概况与行李穿搭建议

地区气候特点衣物装备建议
华南/东南地区夏季湿热；6-9月多雨，存在台风风险轻薄透气夏装、雨衣/折叠雨伞、防晒用品
华北地区（北京、天津等）春秋昼夜温差巨大；冬季严寒结冰分层穿搭；冬季准备厚实保暖外套
西部高原（青海、西藏）紫外线极强，即便夏天昼夜温差也很大防晒霜、遮阳帽、太阳镜；夏季也需要备长袖分层衣物
西南山区湿度高，全年经常小雨防水鞋子、便携雨具

实操出行提示

天气变化速度快。每去往一座新城市，提前查询当地多日天气预报，灵活调整携带衣物。

重要提醒

高原区域即便夏季，夜间气温会降得很低，不要只带短袖类服饰。

titleEn: Photography Rules for Foreign Travellers in China: What You Can and Cannot Shoot, Practical Reminders
titleZh: 外国游客在中国拍照：哪些可以拍、哪些严禁拍摄｜实操提醒
summaryEn: General tourist sightseeing-photography is mostly permitted in China. However certain sites are legally prohibited for photographing. This article lists restricted-locations, portrait-right etiquette to help foreign-visitors avoid unnecessary troubles during travel.
summaryZh: 普通旅游观光拍照在中国大部分场景允许，但部分场所法律禁止拍摄。本文列出禁止拍摄地点、肖像权礼仪，帮助外国游客旅行途中规避不必要麻烦。
contentEn:
Locations where photography is strictly prohibited

  • Military facilities, military-bases, military-controlled airports and national-defense-related installations.
  • Museum exhibition-halls with clear “No Photography” warning-signs (some relics cannot be photographed even without-flash).
  • Special security-sensitive government-related restricted-installations.

Locations you are allowed to take photos

Ordinary scenic-spots, city streets, public squares, historical-monuments, commercial pedestrian-streets are all permitted for tourist-photography.

Portrait-right etiquette reminder

  • Do not take close-up portrait photos of random strangers without obtaining their explicit consent.
  • If you want to take photo of local residents, politely ask for permission in advance.

Common-misunderstanding FAQ

  • Q: Can I take photos of police-officers on public-street?
    A: Avoid close-up shooting of police-officers performing official-duty; distant street-scene background-shots are generally fine.
contentZh:
严格禁止拍照的场所

  • 军事设施、军事基地、军用机场以及国防相关装置设施。
  • 张贴明确禁止拍照标识的博物馆展厅；部分文物展厅即使关闭闪光灯也不允许拍摄。
  • 特殊安保敏感的政府管控设施。

可以正常拍照的地点

普通旅游景区、城市街道、公共广场、历史古迹、商业步行街，都允许游客拍照留念。

肖像权礼仪提醒

  • 未经明确许可，不要对陌生路人进行特写人像拍摄。
  • 如果想要拍摄当地居民，建议提前礼貌征得对方同意。

常见误区问答

  • 问：街上执勤警察可以拍照吗？
    答：不要近距离特写拍摄正在执行公务的警务人员；远景城市环境背景取景一般没有问题。

titleEn: Customs Declaration Guide: What Items Need to Declare When Entering China, Prohibited & Restricted Goods Checklist
titleZh: 入境中国海关申报指南｜哪些物品必须申报，违禁/受限物品清单
summaryEn: Many inbound travellers overlook customs-declaration rules and risk having their belongings detained or fined. This article clarifies cash-declaration threshold, food-plant quarantine rules, prohibited imports, green-channel / red-channel usage and practical declaration tips for foreign visitors.
summaryZh: 不少入境旅客忽视海关申报规定，造成物品被扣甚至被处罚。本文说明现金申报门槛、食品动植物检疫要求、禁止入境品类、红绿通道使用规则，给到外籍游客实操申报提示。
contentEn:
Key declaration thresholds

  • Cash & negotiable securities: When carrying cash equivalent to 5000 US-dollars or above, you must make customs declaration upon arrival.
  • Goods exceeding personal-use quantity or value limit should go through red-channel for declaration.

Typical restricted & prohibited import items table

CategoryRegulation Description
Fresh food & plant-derived goodsFresh fruits, raw meat, unpasteurized dairy products are generally prohibited import for biosecurity purpose; processed packaged food still needs inspection.
Hazardous articlesNarcotic drugs, weapons, ammunition, explosive substances are strictly forbidden.
Print & mediaObscene, reactionary publications and video materials are prohibited from entering mainland China.

Green Channel vs Red Channel

  • Green Channel (no-declaration): Only use if you carry zero-declaration-required articles, all goods are within personal-use scope.
  • Red Channel (declaration-required): Use this channel whenever you hold items that need to be declared; fill-in customs-declaration form (paper or electronic).

Practical travel advice

  • When you are uncertain whether your belongings need declaration, choose Red Channel to avoid subsequent penalty risk.
  • You may use WeChat / Alipay mini-program for pre-arrival electronic customs declaration before landing.
  • Customs hotline 12360 is available for multilingual policy consultation.

FAQ

  • Q: Do I need to declare my personal laptop and camera?
    A: Personal-use electronic devices you will take out upon departure generally do not require declaration.
contentZh:
核心申报门槛

  • 现金及有价证券：携带等值5000美元及以上现金，入境时必须向海关进行申报。
  • 超出个人自用数量、价值限额的物品，需要走红色申报通道。

常见受限、禁止入境物品一览表

品类规则说明
生鲜食品、动植物制品新鲜水果、生肉、未灭菌乳制品，出于生物安全管控一般禁止入境；预包装加工食品仍有可能接受查验。
危险物品毒品、武器弹药、爆炸类物品严禁携带入境。
出版物音像制品淫秽、反动的书籍影音资料禁止带入中国大陆。

海关红绿通道区分

  • 绿色通道（无申报）：仅当你完全没有需要申报物品，全部行李属于个人自用，才可走此通道。
  • 红色通道（需申报）：只要携带需要申报物品，务必走红色通道，填写纸质或电子申报单。

实操出行建议

  • 拿不准行李物品是否要申报，优先选择红色申报通道，规避后续罚款风险。
  • 落地前可以通过微信、支付宝小程序提前完成电子海关申报。
  • 海关咨询热线12360，可多语种咨询政策。

高频问答

  • 问：个人笔记本电脑、相机需要申报吗？
    答：属于个人自用、离境会随身带走的电子设备，一般不需要申报。

titleEn: Travel Insurance Suggestions for Visa-Free Visitors Coming to China: Is It Mandatory? Coverage Selection Guide
titleZh: 免签来华游客旅行保险选购建议｜是强制要求吗？保障范围挑选指南
summaryEn: Travel insurance is NOT a mandatory document for China unilateral, mutual or transit visa-free border inspection. Even so, overseas tourists are strongly advised to purchase proper travel-insurance covering medical cost, emergency evacuation and trip interruption for their stay in China.
summaryZh: 旅行保险不属于中国单方面免签、互免签证、过境免签入境时边检强制查验材料。即便如此，强烈建议外籍游客购买合适旅行保险，覆盖医疗开销、紧急救援以及行程中断损失。
contentEn:
Is travel-insurance legally mandatory for visa-free entry?

For unilateral visa-free, mutual visa-exemption and 240-hour transit visa-free entry, travel-insurance will not be checked as mandatory document by Chinese border-inspection officers. You will not be refused entry solely because you do not hold insurance policy.

Why you still need travel-insurance for China trip

  • Medical treatment expense for foreigners inside mainland China can be high, especially for international-clinic or emergency rescue / medical evacuation service.
  • Qualified travel-insurance can cover outpatient & inpatient medical bills, emergency medical evacuation, trip-cancellation or flight-delay compensation.

Key points for policy selection checklist

Check-ItemRequirement Note
Territory coveragePolicy must explicitly include mainland-China; distinguish whether Hong Kong / Macau are included according to your real itinerary.
Medical coverage amountGive priority to policies with sufficient medical expense and emergency-evacuation limit.
Policy effective timeInsurance valid period must fully cover your whole stay window inside China.

Important reminder

Having travel-insurance cannot change your immigration-status rules. Insurance will NOT grant you rights for extending visa-free stay when you encounter travel-accidents. In force-majeure incidents you still need to apply for stay-permit via local Exit-Entry-Administration Bureau.
contentZh:
免签入境，旅行保险属于强制材料吗？

单方面免签、互免签证、240小时过境免签入境，旅行保险不是中国边检强制核验文件，不会单纯因为没有保险就拒绝游客入境。

但依然强烈建议购买保险的原因

  • 外籍人员在中国大陆就医开销可能较高，尤其是国际诊所、紧急转运救援服务费用昂贵。
  • 合格旅行保险可以覆盖门诊住院医疗费用、紧急医疗转运、行程取消或者航班延误补偿。

保险选购核对要点清单

核对项目要求说明
保障地域保单必须明确包含中国大陆；根据真实行程确认是否覆盖中国香港、中国澳门。
医疗保额优先选择医疗费用、紧急救援额度充足的产品。
保单生效时间保险有效期完整覆盖你全部在华停留时间段。

重要提醒

购买旅行保险不能改变你的出入境身份规则。发生意外事故，保险不会自动赋予你免签延期资格；遇到不可抗力，依旧需要向当地出入境管理局申请停留证件。

titleEn: Short-term Apartment Rental Rules for Foreign Visitors in China: Homestay Registration & Booking Risk Reminders
titleZh: 外国游客在中国短租民宿公寓注意事项｜民宿住宿登记、预订风险提示
summaryEn: Short-term homestay and apartment rentals are popular for overseas travellers. Unlike formal hotels, private rental accommodation brings special legal obligations for foreigners regarding 24-hour accommodation registration. Many hosts lack relevant regulatory awareness, creating hidden risks for foreign passport holders.
summaryZh: 短租民宿公寓深受海外游客欢迎。但和正规酒店不一样，私人租房涉及外国人24小时住宿登记法定义务。不少房东不熟悉相关管理规定，给持外国护照入住带来潜在风险。
contentEn:
Statutory legal obligation for private short-term rental

If you stay in non-hotel private short-term apartment / homestay, either the foreign guest or the host landlord must complete foreign-national accommodation-registration within 24 hours upon check-in at local police-station or via official 12367 immigration mini-program.

Note: This legal requirement applies regardless of booking platform you use (OTA platform, private direct-deal).

Common booking-risks you need to confirm before paying deposit

Risk ItemVerification Advice before booking
Host cannot receive foreign-passport holdersExplicitly inform host you hold foreign passport, confirm apartment can accept foreign guests before placing order.
Host unfamiliar with registration rulesCommunicate in advance who will handle 24-hour accommodation-registration procedure (host or yourself).
Housing location outside police-station service coverageConfirm address belongs to valid local police-jurisdiction for foreign-resident registration.

Consequence of missed registration in homestay

Failing to finish accommodation-registration within 24-hours can result in warning or administrative fine for both tenant and host. You may also face obstacles when you need to go through exit-formalities.

Practical booking-tip

Prefer properties whose host has previous experience receiving foreign guests. Avoid homestays whose host refuses to handle registration related-matters.
contentZh:
私人短租的法定义务

入住非酒店的私人短租公寓、民宿，外籍住客本人或者房东，必须在入住24小时之内完成外国人住宿登记，办理渠道为辖区派出所或者官方移民12367小程序。

提示：无论你通过哪个平台预订（OTA平台、私下直租），这条法律义务均生效。

付定金前务必确认的常见预订风险

风险项下单前核实建议
房源不接待外国护照持有人提前明确告知房东你持外国护照，确认该民宿可以接待外籍客人再下单。
房东不懂住宿登记规则提前沟通好由谁（房东或者你本人）完成24小时住宿登记手续。
房屋地址无法做外籍登记确认房屋地址属于派出所可以办理外国人住宿登记的管辖范围。

民宿漏登记带来的后果

24小时之内没有完成住宿登记，租客与房东都有可能被警告或者处以行政罚款，后续出境手续也有可能遭遇阻碍。

预订实操建议

优先选择有接待外国人过往经验的房源。如果房东明确拒绝配合登记相关事宜，请不要预订该套民宿。

titleEn: Chinese Airport Security Check Tips for Foreign Air Passengers: Domestic Flight Luggage & ID Rules
titleZh: 外国旅客国内机场安检、乘机实用提示｜国内航班行李与证件规定
summaryEn: Airport security-screening standards inside mainland-China differ from many overseas-countries. This article explains liquid-rules, power-bank restrictions and strict physical-passport requirement for domestic flights to help foreign-visitors pass security-check smoothly.
summaryZh: 中国大陆机场安检标准和很多海外国家存在差异。本文讲解液态物品规定、充电宝限制，以及国内航班必须出示实体护照的硬性要求，帮助外国旅客顺利过检。
contentEn:
Carry-on liquid regulation

For hand-carry luggage: every single liquid container volume cannot exceed 100 ml container capacity. All large-volume liquid bottles must go into checked-baggage. Liquid volume refers to container marking capacity, not remaining-liquid-amount inside bottle.

Identity-document requirement for domestic flights inside China

Foreign citizens taking domestic flights within mainland-China must present original physical passport. Digital photo, scanned copy or screenshot of passport are generally NOT accepted for boarding-verification.

Power-bank (portable charger) rules table

Power-bank specificationTransport rule
≤100WhAllowed in carry-on baggage; forbidden inside checked luggage.
100-160WhNeeds airline-approval before flight; can only be carried-on, cannot check-in.
＞160WhStrictly prohibited for air-transport.

Extra practical reminder

  • Arrive at airport earlier for domestic flights; allow enough waiting-time for security-check and identity-verification.
  • Sharp objects such as large scissors, knives cannot go into hand-carry luggage and must be checked-in.
contentZh:
随身液态物品规定

随身手提行李：每一个液态物品容器容积不得超过100毫升（容器标注容积，不是瓶内剩余液体量）。大瓶液体全部需要放入托运行李。

中国境内国内航班证件要求

外国人乘坐中国大陆境内国内航班，必须出示实体护照原件。护照照片、扫描件、截图，一般不允许作为登机核验凭证。

充电宝（移动电源）运输规则表

充电宝规格运输规定
≤100瓦时仅允许随身携带；严禁放入托运行李。
100-160瓦时需要航司提前审批；只能随身携带，禁止托运。
＞160瓦时严禁航空运输。

额外实操提醒

  • 乘坐国内航班建议适当提早抵达机场，预留充足安检、证件核验等待时间。
  • 大剪刀、刀具等尖锐物品不可以随身带上飞机，必须办理托运。

titleEn: Chinese Public Holiday Travel Warning: Crowds, High-Speed-Rail Ticket Shortage & Hotel Price Surge
titleZh: 中国法定节假日出行提醒｜人流爆满、高铁票难抢、酒店涨价注意事项
summaryEn: During major Chinese public-holidays, domestic travel demand explodes. High-speed-rail tickets sell-out rapidly, hotel prices rise sharply and scenic-spots are overcrowded. This article informs foreign-visitors of peak-season impact and booking strategies.
summaryZh: 中国重大法定节假日国内出游需求爆发，高铁车票快速售罄，酒店价格大幅上涨，景区人山人海。本文向外国游客说明高峰出行影响，以及预订应对策略。
contentEn:
Three largest domestic travel-rush periods in China

  • Spring Festival (Chinese Lunar New Year holiday)
  • May Day Labour Day holiday (May 1-5 every year)
  • National Day holiday (Oct 1-7 every year)

Real-world travel-impact during peak-holiday periods

Travel ItemPeak-Holiday Phenomenon
High-speed-rail ticketsPopular-route tickets sell-out within minutes once released; hard to get last-minute-tickets.
Hotel accommodationRoom rates may rise 2-3 times compared with normal weekday price.
Famous scenic-spotsMassive tourist-flow; advance real-name reservation required for most attractions.

Practical travel-suggestions for foreign-visitors

  • If possible, arrange travel-schedule to avoid these three major holiday-windows.
  • If you have to travel during holiday period: book train-tickets and hotel accommodation several weeks ahead of schedule.
  • Many scenic-spots require real-name advance-reservation; check official-booking-channel before you visit.

FAQ

  • Q: Can I buy high-speed-rail ticket on-site during national-day holiday?
    A: Very risky; popular-routes are usually sold-out in advance, almost no walk-up-tickets available.
contentZh:
国内三大旅游高峰节假日

  • 春节（农历新年假期）
  • 五一劳动节假期（每年5月1-5日）
  • 十一国庆节假期（每年10月1-7日）

节假日高峰对出行的实际影响

出行项目节假日高峰现象
高铁车票热门线路车票放票后短时间抢光；临近出行很难买到票。
酒店住宿房费相比平日上涨2-3倍属于常见情况。
知名景区游客流量巨大；绝大多数景点要求提前实名预约。

外国游客实操出行建议

  • 条件允许，尽量避开这三大节假日窗口规划行程。
  • 如果节假日必须出行，提前数周预订火车票与酒店。
  • 大量景区实行实名预约制度，出行前查询官方预约渠道。

问答

  • 问：国庆期间到车站现场能买到高铁票吗？
    答：风险很高，热门线路一般提前售罄，几乎无现场余票。

titleEn: Detailed Consequences of Overstaying Your Visa-Free Period in China: Fines, Records, Deportation & Entry-Ban
titleZh: 免签在中国逾期停留完整后果说明｜罚款、记录、遣返、入境限制详解
summaryEn: Overstaying allowed visa-free duration counts as serious immigration violation under Chinese Exit-Entry Administration Law. This article differentiates consequence levels for short minor overstay versus long-term illegal residence, plus correct handling advice once you have overstayed.
summaryZh: 超过免签允许停留期限属于《出境入境管理法》下严重的出入境违法行为。本文区分短期轻微逾期、长期非法滞留对应的不同后果，以及已经发生逾期后的正确处理方式。
contentEn:
Two-tier consequence classification for overstay

Over-stay SituationLegal Consequences
Short-term minor overstay (several days)Monetary fine calculated by overstay days; permanent immigration-violation record saved within national immigration-system.
Long-term illegal stay (longer period)Detention, forced deportation, plus fixed-term entry-ban barring future entry-into-China.

Key important advice

  • Reserve buffer-days in your travel-plan for flight-delay or transport emergency; never schedule departure exactly on expiry-day.
  • Once you have already overstayed, do not hide or avoid authorities. Take initiative to visit local Exit-Entry-Administration-Bureau and follow official-handling-procedures.
  • Immigration violation-record generated by overstay will impact future visa-application and visa-free eligibility assessment for entering China.

Common-misunderstanding FAQ

  • Q: Will short-over-stay be completely erased after several years?
    A: Immigration violation-records will be kept in system; it will influence future entry-review process.
contentZh:
逾期停留两级后果划分

逾期情形对应的法律后果
短期轻微逾期（数日）按逾期天数处以罚款；国家移民系统留存出入境违法记录。
长期非法滞留拘留、强制遣送出境，附加固定年限来华入境限制。

核心重要建议

  • 行程预留缓冲天数应对航班延误、交通突发状况，不要把离境安排刚好卡到期满当天。
  • 一旦已经发生逾期，不要躲藏回避主管部门，主动前往当地出入境管理局，遵从官方处理流程。
  • 逾期产生的出入境违法记录，会影响你未来申请中国签证以及免签入境资格审核。

常见误区问答

  • 问：短期逾期过几年记录会自动消除吗？
    答：出入境违法记录会保存在系统，会对后续入境审核产生影响。

titleEn: Minor / Children Entry Rules Under China Visa-Free Policy: Passport & Guardian-Consent Documents
titleZh: 未成年人儿童免签入境中国相关规则｜护照要求、监护同意材料
summaryEn: Minor foreign-national children can also enjoy China visa-free treatment if they hold eligible ordinary-passport. Special inspection-requirements apply when minors travel without both biological-parents. This article clarifies passport-standard and potential guardian-document-check scenarios.
summaryZh: 符合条件的外籍未成年儿童持普通护照，同样可以享受中国免签政策。当未成年人不与父母双方一同出行时，会触发特殊查验要求。本文讲清护照标准、有可能被要求出示监护材料的场景。
contentEn:
Children visa-free eligibility

Minors holding ordinary-passport from visa-free-qualifying-countries enjoy identical visa-free entry policy as adult-travellers. Passport validity rules are the same for children (≥6-month validity for unilateral / mutual visa-free).

Passport mandatory-requirement for minors

Every minor must hold independent individual-passport. Old-style entries where child info is annotated inside parent-adult-passport are NOT acceptable for entry-inspection.

Scenarios with possible guardian-document-check

  • Minor travels with only one biological-parent.
  • Minor travels under care of third-party guardian (relatives, tour-guide, teachers etc.) without either parent present.
In above-mentioned cases, border-inspectors retain right to ask for guardian-consent letter, birth-certificate or relevant proof-documents for parent-child-relationship. Prepare these documents in advance as precaution, even though it is not requested for every minor passenger.

Practical travel-tip

Carry birth-certificate copy and guardian-consent letter (English-Chinese bilingual version) when minor does not travel together with both-parents, to respond to potential border-inspection inquiry quickly.
contentZh:
儿童免签资格

来自免签资格国家、持有普通护照的未成年人，享受和成年人完全一致的免签入境政策。儿童护照同样遵循有效期规则（单方面/互免签证入境有效期不少于6个月）。

未成年人护照硬性要求

每一名未成年人必须拥有独立个人护照。旧时代把儿童信息批注登记在父母护照内的形式，现在不能用于入境查验。

有可能查验监护材料的出行场景

  • 未成年人只跟随亲生父母其中一方出行。
  • 无父母陪同，由第三方监护人（亲戚、导游、老师等）代为照看出行。
出现以上情形时，边检有权要求出示监护同意书、出生医学证明或者亲子关系佐证文件。并非每一个未成年人都会被查，但建议提前备好材料，有备无患。

实操出行提示

未成年人不和父母双方同行时，携带出生证明副本、中英双语监护同意书，方便快速应对边检问询。

titleEn: Physical & Mental Health Tips for Long-Distance Overseas Travel to China: Jet-Lag, Food Adaptation & Culture-Shock Adjustment
titleZh: 长途来华旅行身心健康注意事项｜时差、饮食适应、文化冲击调节
summaryEn: Long-haul intercontinental flight and cross-cultural travel bring physical tiredness and mental stress. This article shares practical advice on jet-lag adjustment, food-allergy preparation and relieving culture-shock symptoms for overseas tourists visiting China.
summaryZh: 跨洲际长途航班加上跨文化旅行，会带来身体疲惫和心理压力。本文给到海外游客来华的时差调整、食物过敏准备、缓解文化冲击的实操建议。
contentEn:
Jet-lag adjustment tips for long-haul-flight

  • Gradually shift your sleep-wake-schedule several days before departure to adapt to China local-time zone in advance.
  • Drink sufficient plain-water on-board flight; reduce alcohol and caffeine intake during long-distance-flight.
  • After landing, try to expose yourself to natural daylight in daytime; avoid oversleeping in daytime to fix circadian rhythm quickly.

Food-adaptation & food-allergy preparation

Chinese-cuisine has huge regional flavour-differences (spicy, oily, salty etc.). If you suffer from food-allergy (nuts, seafood, gluten etc.), prepare bilingual allergy-warning card showing your allergen information to show restaurant-staff for ordering meals safely.

Mental adjustment for culture-shock

  • Culture-shock feeling (confusion, fatigue, slight anxiety) is very normal for cross-border-travel, do not feel worried when you experience it.
  • Arrange low-intensity rest-days within your travel-itinerary; avoid packing too-many sightseeing-tasks each single-day.
  • Keep simple over-the-counter personal-medicine for minor cold, stomach upset in your hand-luggage.

FAQ

  • Q: How many days does jet-lag usually last for long-haul-flight to China?
    A: Typically takes 2-4 days for most travellers to fully adapt to local time-zone.

titleZh: 重要提示：中国大陆、香港、澳门签证免签规则互相独立｜三套出入境体系
summaryEn: This is one of the most-common and costly travel-misunderstandings: visa-free access for Hong Kong or Macau SAR does NOT grant automatic visa-free eligibility for entering mainland China. Three separate independent immigration-systems operate for mainland-China, Hong Kong SAR and Macau SAR, requiring separate entry-qualification review each time you cross-border.
summaryZh: 这是最高频代价很大的旅行误区：中国香港、中国澳门的免签入境资格不等于可以直接免签进入中国大陆。内地、香港特别行政区、澳门特别行政区运行三套互相独立出入境体系，每次跨境都要分别审核入境资格。
contentEn:
Core independent-immigration-system principle

Mainland China, Hong Kong SAR and Macau SAR implement fully-separate immigration management systems. Having entry-permission for Hong Kong / Macau does not give you legal right to enter mainland-China, and vice-versa.

Example: Your passport allows you stay 90-days visa-free in Hong Kong SAR. You still have to satisfy mainland-China’s visa-free or visa-requirements before travelling onward from Hong Kong into mainland-China.

Common cross-border travel-scenarios explanation

  • Flying into Hong Kong airport and then taking train / bus going into mainland-China: you will go through mainland-China border-inspection and must satisfy mainland-entry-rules.
  • Travelling from mainland-China to Hong Kong / Macau: you will pass Hong Kong / Macau immigration checkpoint, subject to SAR entry-conditions.

Document practical reminder

Whenever you travel back-and-forth between mainland-China and Hong Kong / Macau SAR, you will go through formal immigration-border-check, and your passport will receive corresponding entry-exit stamps. Do not forget to carry original-passport for every-cross-border-trip.

Typical-pitfall warning

Do not assume that you can enter mainland-China simply because you can stay visa-free inside Hong-Kong or Macau. Confirm mainland-entry-qualification before you plan cross-border-route.
contentZh:
出入境体系相互独立核心原则

中国大陆、香港特别行政区、澳门特别行政区执行三套完全独立的出入境管理制度。获得香港或者澳门入境许可，并不代表拥有进入中国大陆的合法资格，反之同理。

举例：你的护照可以在香港免签停留90天。但你从香港进入中国大陆，依然必须满足内地的免签或者签证政策条件。

常见跨境出行场景解读

  • 飞抵香港机场，再搭乘高铁/大巴进入内地：需要接受中国大陆边检查验，必须满足内地入境规则。
  • 从中国大陆前往香港、澳门：需要经过港澳特区出入境关卡，遵守特区入境条件。

证件实操提醒

往返于中国大陆与香港、澳门之间，每一次跨境都会经过正式出入境查验，护照会加盖对应的出入境印章。每一次跨境出行务必携带护照原件。

典型踩坑警示

千万不要以为可以港澳免签，就默认自己可以直接进入中国大陆。规划跨境路线前，确认内地这边的入境资格。
